description: This file defines REST API endpoints for managing 'Skill' entities in a FastAPI application. It includes routes for listing, creating, updating, and deleting skills, with authorization checks and database interactions via SQLAlchemy.

methods.name: List[SkillOut] list_skills(db: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_db)])
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all skills from the database.

methods.name: SkillOut create_skill( payload: SkillCreate, _: Annotated[object, Depends(require_admin)], db: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_db)], )
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new skill, requiring admin privileges.

methods.name: SkillOut update_skill( skill_id: int, payload: SkillUpdate, _: Annotated[object, Depends(require_admin)], db: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_db)], )
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing skill, requiring admin privileges.

methods.name: None delete_skill( skill_id: int, _: Annotated[object, Depends(require_admin)], db: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_db)], )
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a skill, requiring admin privileges.
